rules.label: Sliding Scale Financial Assistance Program
rules.quote: Financial assistance is generally determined by a sliding scale of total household income based on Federal Poverty Guidelines.

notes: Policy mentions service exclusions not typically eligible for financial assistance, including transplants, cosmetic services and other services.

Policy states that no person eligible for financial assistance will be charged more for medically necessary care than amounts generally billed to individuals who have insurance covering such care (AGB).
Policy indicates that if an individual has sufficient insurance coverage or assets available to pay for care, they may be deemed ineligible for financial assistance.
sliding_scale_fap may leave out a condition: Policy requires Colorado residency and being in the hospital's service area for all assistance.
